descriptions.preferred: Acer platanoides 'Drummondii' Rare Norway Maple Zones 4-7 Acer platanoides 'Drummondii', or Drummond Norway Maple, is a variegated deciduous tree known for its green leaves edged in creamy white. It has a broad, rounded form and typically reaches about 13–20 ft in height and spread within the first 10 years. This tree prefers full sun to partial shade and adapts well to various soil types. It's popular in urban and landscape settings for its striking foliage and tolerance of pollution. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer platanoides 'Drummondii' 稀有挪威槭，适生区 4-7。Acer platanoides 'Drummondii'，亦称 Drummond Norway Maple，是一款斑叶落叶乔木，以绿色叶片配奶白色镶边而闻名。树形宽阔圆整，前 10 年通常可长至约 13-20 英尺高，冠幅相近。适合全日照至半阴环境，对多种土壤类型适应性良好。因叶色醒目且耐污染，常用于城市绿化和园林景观。此规格为 10 加仑容器苗，仅支持本地自提，因植株过大无法邮寄。MrMaple Nursery 位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，请联系我们安排提货时间。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，每个品种通常库存不多，建议尽快购买心仪品种，因为部分选育品种经常很快售罄。
